$description: ASTRA brand colours, in the Design Tokens (DTCG) format. This file is the source: tools/build_logo.py draws the logo with these values and generates tokens/colors.css from them. The values come from the Lightcone Research palette and the dark scheme of its ASTRA adapter.

light.$description: For light grounds: parchment, white, light photographs.

ink.$description: Stars, the option ring and the wordmark. Lightcone Charcoal.

link.$description: Links between stars and the descriptor line. Lightcone Blue Ink.

gold.$description: The selected option, its path and the result, and nothing else. Lightcone Antique Gold, the colour of the decision record kind in ASTRA UI.

rule.$description: Hairline frames and rules on light grounds.

dark.$description: For dark grounds: charcoal, near-black, dark photographs.

ink.$description: Stars, the option ring and the wordmark. Lightcone Darker Parchment.

link.$description: Links between stars and the descriptor line. Blue Ink lifted for dark grounds.

gold.$description: The selected option, its path and the result. Antique Gold lifted for dark grounds.

rule.$description: Hairline frames and rules on dark grounds.
